title: Apophis I
summary: King listed in CFAH-8 Table 6 (Egypt Dynasty 15 (Hyksos)).
description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasty 15 (Hyksos). Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-8 (Table 6, "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 15").

sorting_basis.note: Sorted by reign start (CFAH non-anchor dates). No tier 1–4 birth year. The year is the reign-start figure already printed on dates.reign: Start Sole-rex: 1392; Death or Deposition: 1331. Sort changed by the CFAH pass (2026-11-13): was none.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-8: Placing Dynasties 15-18," OSF preprint v1.2 (29 Apr 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/Z5RTD, file CFAH-8_v1.2.pdf, Table 6 "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 15", p. 87
BLK SHP Scott, Dynasty of Slaves, Chapter 3, War for the Nile
reign.note: Year he gives for Avaris as the center under the king he spells Apepi. Reused apophis-i. Not an accession, and not apophis-iii.

reign.citation: BLK SHP Scott, Dynasty of Slaves, Chapter 3, A Warrior Pharaoh Wages War
reign.note: Year the Hebrew rulers of Avaris felt secure after Seqenenre Tao and Kamose. Not a printed death year for either man.
